words.sz: 和东京比，伦敦很小。

牺牲，牺牲品；献祭，供奉；祭品，供物
words.s: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
words.sz: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？
words.d: To sacrifice is to give up something in order to get something you want or do something else for someone.

t: 特殊的，特别的；特定的，个别的；详细的
详情， 细目， 细节
words.s: I want to emphasize this point in particular.
words.sz: 我想特别强调这一点。
words.d: If something is particular, then it is a single, important part of a group of things.

words.s: In Canada, there are many areas where it is illegal to log trees.
words.sz: 在加拿大有很多區域砍伐樹木是非法的。

words.s: The army had a corps of archers who trained apart from the regular soldiers.
words.d: A corps is a division of a military force.

t: 品尝，品味；欣赏；体会，体味
味道， 风味； 情趣， 吸引力

words.s: Bill and Angela congratulated each other on a job well done.
words.d: To congratulate someone is to tell them that you are happy for them.

words.s: There's no need for you to prepare a formal speech.
words.sz: 您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。
words.d: A formal thing is official or serious.

t: 结合， 团结； 凝聚力
欢乐， 娱乐； 招待
words.s: The clown entertained the kids at the party.
words.d: To entertain someone is to do something that they enjoy.

t: 批评的， 评论的； 危急的， 紧要的； 临界的； 挑剔的
words.s: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
words.sz: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。

t: 校长； 资本； 主角
words.s: Our school's principal is very old.
words.sz: 我校校长很老了。
words.d: A principal is a person in charge of a school.

t: 倾向于， 趋于； 照料； 招待
words.s: Lonely people tend to be afraid of meeting others, which ensures they will always be lonely.
words.sz: 孤獨的人會孤獨，是因為他畏懼他人。
words.d: To tend to do something is to be likely to do it or to do it often.

t: 范例， 样品； 样本， 标本
外来的； 奇异的； 醒目的， 吸引人的
words.s: Rebecca tried many exotic foods on her trip to Africa.
words.d: Exotic describes something unusual because it is from far away.

t: 减轻， 解除； 援救， 救济； 安慰； 缓合剂
words.s: This medicine will give you some relief.
words.sz: 这药会让你舒服些。
words.d: Relief is a good feeling after something bad or challenging ends.

t: 介绍； 传入， 引进； 导言， 绪论
草本植物志； 药草书
订阅， 订购； 申请， 预订
words.s: What newspaper do you subscribe to?
words.sz: 你訂閱了什麼報紙?
words.d: To subscribe to something is to agree with it.

words.s: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
words.sz: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。
words.d: Therapy is treatment for a particular physical or mental illness or condition.

t: 集中； 专心， 专注； 浓缩， 浓度
速度， 速率； 迅速， 快速
干涉， 干扰， 妨碍
words.s: You have no right to interfere in other people's affairs.
words.sz: 你沒有干涉他人事務的權力。
words.d: To interfere is to cause problems and keep something from happening.

t: 装入胶囊； 压缩； 总结， 概述

words.s: I'd like to try this on. Where are the fitting rooms?
words.sz: 我想试试这件。请问哪里是试衣间？

t: 容忍， 宽容； 容许， 承认
words.s: I can't tolerate this noise any longer.
words.sz: 我不能再忍受這個噪音了。
words.d: To tolerate something means to be able to accept it even when it is unpleasant.

t: 把…叠成堆， 堆放于； 堆积， 堆起
words.s: Tom put a stack of letters on Mary's desk.
words.sz: 湯姆把一疊信放在瑪麗桌上。
words.d: A stack is a pile of different things.

t: 愤恨； 对…表示愤恨， 感到气愤
words.s: Why do you resent me?
words.sz: 你为什么恨我？
words.d: To resent something means to have bad feelings about it.

t: 哑剧表演； 哑剧演员
含糊其辞的； 不明确的， 模棱两可的
words.s: This sentence is ambiguous.
words.sz: 此句有歧義
words.d: If something is ambiguous, it is not entirely clear.

t: 破裂； 发出爆裂声； 重击； 崩溃， 瓦解
words.s: The old window was covered with cracks.
words.d: A crack is a narrow space between the parts of something broken.

t: 捆绑， 系； 约束； 凝结
words.s: The victims of the flood were bound by their need to help each other.
words.d: To bind people is to make them feel united together.

words.s: This is an ice cube.
words.sz: 這是冰塊。
words.d: A cube is a solid object with six square surfaces that are all the same size.

words.s: My favorite snack is a bag of crisp, delicious potato chips.
words.d: When food is crisp, it is hard or has a hard surface in a way that is pleasant.

t: 温柔的； 温和的； 轻微的
words.s: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
words.sz: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。

t: 影响， 作用； 冲击
words.s: My grandmother had a great impact on my life.
words.d: An impact is the effect someone or something has.

t: 面部的侧影，侧面轮廓；传略，人物简介
words.s: The drawing of Olivia’s profile came out very well.
words.d: A profile is an outline of a face, usually as seen from the side.

t: 瘫痪， 麻痹， 中风
words.s: His paralysis meant that he had to use a wheelchair to get around.
words.d: Paralysis is the loss of the ability to move all or part of your body.

words.s: Have you gotten used to living in the dorm?
words.sz: 你習慣在宿舍生活了嗎？

words.s: Please fill this bucket with water.
words.sz: 請把這個桶子裝滿水。
words.d: A bucket is a round container to put things in.

t: 较年长者； 毕业班学生
words.s: She gave her seat to a senior citizen.
words.sz: 她把她的座位让给了一个老人。
words.d: A senior person is older or more experienced.

words.s: My mother gave me a dose of medicine before I went to bed.
words.d: A dose is a certain amount of medicine taken at one time.

t: 胡乱涂抹；弄脏，弄污；诽谤，诋毁；变得模糊不清，
可延伸的， 可展开的， 可扩张的
相对的；比较的；有关的，相关的
words.s: Tom is a distant relative of mine.
words.sz: 湯姆是我的遠亲。
words.d: A relative is a family member.

t: 态度， 看法； 姿势
words.s: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
words.sz: 抱著失敗主義的態度你無法打一場漂亮的仗。
words.d: Someone’s attitude is the way they feel and think.

words.s: The average height of girls in this class is over 155 centimeters.
words.sz: 这个班的女生平均身高超过了155公分。
words.d: If something is average, it is at a normal level.

words.s: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
words.sz: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

words.s: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
words.sz: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
words.d: To compare means to say how two things are the same and different.

t: 有影响力的； 有权势的
words.s: He is very influential in the world of medicine.
words.sz: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。

t: 透明的， 清澈的； 明显的； 易懂的
抓住； 支配； 理解
words.s: He has a good grasp of English.
words.sz: 他精通英文。
words.d: To grasp something means to hold it.

t: 杂志； 日报； 日志
words.s: My dad keeps a journal every day.
words.sz: 我爸爸每天都记日记。
words.d: A journal is a type of magazine that deals with an academic subject.

words.s: Olives have a distinctive flavor.
words.d: When something is distinctive, it has a special quality, character, or appearance that is different and easy to recognize.

t: 作品； 写作， 作曲； 结构， 组成， 成分
words.s: I had my composition corrected by the teacher.
words.sz: 我把我的作文拿給老師訂正。

t: 交付， 委托； 投递， 发送； 所托运的货物
使肥沃， 使多产； 施肥于； 使受精

words.s: The volcano erupted suddenly, killing many people.
words.sz: 火山突然喷发，造成了多人死亡。
words.d: A volcano is a mountain with a hole on top where hot liquid comes out.

words.s: Marty was happy with his new acquisition: a very fast bicycle.
words.d: An acquisition is something that a person buys or gets in some way.

t: 严格的， 死板的； 刚硬的， 僵硬的
words.s: Societies often have rigid rules about the way that people are supposed to act.
words.d: When rules or systems are rigid, they are severe because they cannot be changed.

words.s: You must get the job done before the deadline.
words.sz: 你必须在到期前完成这项工作。
words.d: A deadline is the time by which you need to have something completed.

words.s: I'd be grateful to you if you could teach me to do that.
words.sz: 如果你能教我怎麼做，我會很感激。
words.d: A grateful person feels thankful about something.

t: 零售商人； 复述者， 传播者

words.s: During the advent of radio, very few programs actually played music.
words.d: An advent is the arrival or beginning of an important person, thing, or event.

words.s: We visited a castle that was built during medieval times.
words.d: If something is medieval, it comes from the period between 650 and 1500 CE.

t: 运转的； 操作的； 运营的， 业务的
全体职工，工作人员；棒；全体参谋人员
为…配备人员； 任职于
words.s: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
words.sz: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。
words.d: A staff is a group of people working together in a company.

t: 使卷入， 使参与； 牵涉， 陷入， 连累； 包含， 含有
words.s: I didn't mean to involve you.
words.sz: 我沒想要讓你牽扯進來。
words.d: To involve means to include as an active participant.

t: 油轮； 油罐车； 加油飞机
舞台； 戏剧； 阶段
words.s: Are there any famous musicians on the stage?
words.sz: 舞台上有著名音乐家吗？
words.d: A stage is a place where actors or musicians act or sing.

words.s: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.
words.sz: 电脑可以做极为复杂的工作。

words.s: The maximum driving speed here is 80 km/h.
words.d: Maximum is the highest amount of anything allowed.

words.s: The Sahara is a vast desert.
words.sz: 撒哈拉沙漠广袤无垠。
words.d: The desert is an area of land without many plants or water.

t: 紧急情况， 突发事件
words.s: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
words.sz: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
words.d: An emergency is a time when someone needs help right away.

t: 才能； 学院， 系； 全体教学人员
words.s: The boy’s mental faculties impressed all of his teachers.
words.d: A faculty is a mental or physical ability.

t: 护照； 途径， 路子， 手段
words.s: She was in trouble because she lost her passport.
words.sz: 她遇到了麻煩，因為她弄丟了她的護照。

words.s: I have no clue.
words.sz: 我一无所知。
words.d: A clue is a fact or object that helps solve a mystery or crime.

words.s: The legal system in America is the world's finest.
words.sz: 美國的司法制度是世界上最好的。
words.d: If something is legal, it is related to the law or allowed by the law.

words.s: She was in the midst of cleaning when the telephone rang.
words.d: The midst of something is the middle of it.

words.s: The accident took place on the highway.
words.sz: 事故發生在高速公路上。

t: 半径； 周围， 范围

words.s: He gave us the signal to begin.
words.sz: 他給了我們開始的信號。
words.d: A signal is a sound or action that tells someone to do something.

words.s: Regularly eating too much can impair your health.
words.d: To impair something means to make it weaker or worse.

words.s: The address on this parcel is wrong.
words.sz: 這個包裹上的地址是錯的。
words.d: A parcel is a package of things to be carried or mailed somewhere.

t: 使非常疲倦， 使疲惫不堪； 用尽， 耗尽
words.s: Car exhaust causes serious pollution in towns.
words.sz: 汽车尾气在城镇里造成了严重的污染。
words.d: To exhaust someone is to make that person tired.

t: 定罪； 坚信， 确信

words.s: She put the strap of her purse over her shoulder and walked out the door.
words.d: A strap is a thin long piece of fabric used to fasten, carry, or hold something.

words.s: I drank the orange juice through a straw.
words.d: A straw is a thin tube that is used to suck liquid into the mouth.

t: 发明的， 创造的； 善于发明创造的
words.s: The inventive student built a robot to help her with her chores.
words.d: When someone is inventive, they are good at creating new things.

t: 图， 图表， 曲线图
自命不凡的， 自负的； 炫耀的； 做作的
对付，处理；向某人提起；抢截，抢球
用具， 器具； 滑轮， 滑车； 抢截
words.s: Such social problems need to be tackled right away.
words.d: To tackle something means to deal with it in a determined and efficient way.

t: 大规模的， 大范围的

words.s: Don't distract me while I am studying.
words.sz: 我学习的时候不要打扰我。
words.d: To distract someone means to stop them from concentrating on something.

t: 时刻，时候；场合；重大活动，盛会；时机，机会；起因，理由
words.s: What's the happy occasion?
words.sz: 什么事这么开心？

t: 压榨，榨取；捏，挤压；挤入，挤过；向…勒索
挤压， 捏； 紧缺， 拮据， 经济困难； 减少， 削减
words.s: When Clara saw her cat, she squeezed it to her face.
words.d: To squeeze something means to press it together and hold it tightly.

words.s: I told Tom I'd be willing to loan him some money.
words.sz: 我告诉汤姆我愿意借给他一些钱。
words.d: A loan is something, usually money, that one person lends to another.

words.s: His behavior is worthy of respect.
words.sz: 他的行为值得尊重。

t: 狂饮， 暴饮； 大量消耗
药剂师， 配药师； 分配者， 施予者； 自动售货机
持续， 持续的时间， 期间
words.s: The girls watched television for the duration of the evening.
words.d: The duration of an event is the time during which it happens.

words.s: The man loaded the boxes into a truck.
words.d: To load is to put objects into something.

t: 久经世故的人； 精通者

words.s: The ferry took the people across the lake.
words.d: A ferry is a boat that carries passengers over short distances.

t: 服水土； 适应新环境
不顾， 不理， 忽视
words.s: It wouldn't be wise to ignore Tom completely.
words.sz: 完全忽视汤姆不会是明智的。
words.d: To ignore something is to act like you do not see or hear it.

words.s: Japan is located in the Northern Hemisphere.
words.sz: 日本位於北半球。
words.d: A hemisphere is one half of the Earth.

words.s: All of us would like to get rid of nuclear weapons.
words.sz: 我們所有的人都想除掉核子武器。
words.d: A nuclear thing relates to the division or joining of atoms.

t: 鼓掌， 喝彩； 称赞
words.s: Everyone cheered and applauded Manny’s efforts.
words.d: To applaud means to clap in order to show approval.

words.s: During a lunar eclipse, Earth’s shadow darkens the moon’s surface.
words.d: If something is lunar, then it is related to the moon.

words.s: Tom wanted to stay home and relax instead of hiking with his children.
words.sz: 汤姆想待在家休息而不是和他的孩子们出去远足。
words.d: To relax is to rest or do something enjoyable.

words.s: The teacher granted me permission to go home early.
words.sz: 老師允許我提前回家。
words.d: Permission means the act of allowing some action.

words.s: The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.
words.sz: 一等奖是公主的香吻。
words.d: Something grand is big and liked by people.

t: 扩散， 弥漫； 渗透， 渗入

words.s: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
words.sz: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？
words.d: A schedule is a plan that tells you when to do things.

words.s: The lack of care led to the deterioration of the house.
words.d: Deterioration is the act of becoming worse.

t: 解释， 说明； 口译， 翻译
words.s: It is difficult to interpret while someone is speaking.
words.d: When you interpret something, you find its meaning, often by changing it into a different language.

t: 宇宙， 天地万物； 世界； 领域
words.s: The universe is limitless.
words.sz: 宇宙浩瀚無邊。

words.s: Could I have a pillow and blanket?
words.sz: 給我一個枕頭和毛毯好嗎？
words.d: A blanket is a piece of cloth that people use to keep warm or to sit upon.

t: 同意， 承认； 给予， 授予
授予物；补助金，助学金，津贴；授权
words.s: The teacher granted us a break after studying hard all day.
words.d: To grant something is to allow someone to have it.

t: 时事通讯， 业务通讯
能传导电的， 导电的
给…打折； 漠视， 低估
words.s: For quantities of 20 or more, we can allow you a special discount of 10% on the prices quoted.
words.sz: 20个以上九折特惠。

words.s: After reading his books I feel I can construct a house.
words.sz: 讀完他的書後，我覺得我可以構建一棟房子。
words.d: To construct something means to make or build it.

t: 改变信仰， 皈依； 转变， 转化； 改装
words.s: The man converted his messy field into a garden of flowers.
words.d: To convert something means to change it into something else.

t: 尝试， 试图； 努力
words.s: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
words.sz: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。
words.d: An attempt is an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult.

t: 分开， 分隔； 分配； 分歧； 除； 部门， 科， 司
words.s: The children haven't studied division yet.
words.sz: 孩子們還沒上過除法。

t: 航空， 航海， 航行； 导航， 领航

words.s: The cookies sat on the table so long that they became stale.
words.d: If food is stale, then it is not fresh but dry, hard, and not good to eat.

words.s: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
words.sz: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。
words.d: Balance is when two or more things are equal.

t: 沥青； 场地； 程度； 最高点； 音高
words.s: This is a good place to pitch a tent.
words.sz: 这是搭帐篷的好地方。

words.s: My sister loves horror movies, whereas I prefer comedies.
words.d: You use whereas to show how two things are different.

t: 洪流； 爆发； 连发
电的， 电学的， 有关电的
words.s: Keep away from the electrical equipment.
words.sz: 遠離電器設備。

words.s: The statue of Hachiko, the faithful dog, stands in front of Shibuya Station.
words.sz: 忠犬八公的雕像伫立在涩谷站前。
words.d: A statue is a three-dimensional work of art, usually made of clay, marble, or metal.

words.s: If you give the car a push, it won’t stall.
words.d: To stall means to stop a process and continue it at a later time.

words.s: According to scientific classification, a duck-billed platypus is an egg-laying mammal.
words.d: Classification means putting things into categories or groups that have things in common.

t: 酿造； 冲泡； 酝酿
words.s: Please brew a fresh pot of coffee.
words.d: To brew coffee or tea means to pour hot water over it.

words.s: The curry at this restaurant is good.
words.sz: 这家饭馆的咖哩挺好。

t: 声称， 自命； 自负， 自命不凡
有道德的， 品性好的， 品德高的； 自命清高的； 贞洁的
无效的，作废的；无可靠根据的，站不住脚的；有病的，伤残的['ɪnvælɪd]
words.s: The way to winning debates is to avoid invalid arguments.
words.d: If something is invalid, it is not correct.

t: 同步发生， 同速进行
合法的， 法定的； 正当的， 合情合理的
words.s: She found a legitimate plan to raise extra funds for her vacation.
words.d: If something is legitimate, then it is acceptable according to the law.

t: 间隔， 幕间休息； 间距
words.s: Tony rested for brief intervals while he worked in the yard.
words.d: An interval is the time between two things happening.

t: 世界主义者； 四海为家者
words.s: There are dozens of different types of restaurants in a cosmopolitan city.
words.d: When a place is cosmopolitan, it is full of people from many different places.

words.s: Jo and Ken evaluated the plan and agreed that it would work.
words.d: To evaluate something means to study it, so a decision can be made.

t: 地位； 身份； 状况
words.s: She had achieved the status of being the smartest girl in the class.
words.d: Status is the position of something or someone in relation to others.

words.s: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.
words.sz: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。

t: 打点于； 散布于， 点缀
撇去； 掠过， 擦过； 浏览， 略读

words.s: Please don't forget to put a stamp on the letter before mailing it.
words.sz: 请不要忘记寄信前要在上面贴邮票。

t: 跳， 蹦； 漏过； 逃学
words.s: It's no crime to skip breakfast once in a while.
words.sz: 偶爾不吃早餐也不會如何不好呀。
words.d: To skip something is to not do it.

words.s: The organization disseminates information about the dangers of smoking.
words.d: To disseminate information or knowledge means to distribute it.

t: 大批离去， 成群外出

words.s: He knows German and French, not to mention English.
words.sz: 不提英语，他还会说德语和法语。
words.d: To mention something is to talk about it.

words.s: A stream of people came out of the theater.
words.sz: 剧场里涌出一大群人。

words.s: I don't like to use liquid laundry detergent.
words.sz: 我不喜歡用洗衣液。
words.d: Laundry is clothes that have been or need to be washed.

words.s: The mail accumulated in their mailbox while they were on vacation.
words.d: To accumulate something is to collect a lot of it over time.

words.s: There were three uniformed police officers at the crime scene.
words.sz: 犯罪现场有三名穿制服的警察。
words.d: If someone commits a crime, he or she does something bad that can be punished by law.

words.s: We surrounded the suspect on all four sides.
words.d: To surround something is to close in on it from all sides.

words.s: She spends her leisure time making dolls.
words.sz: 她利用空闲时间做布娃娃。

t: 人行道； 地面， 路面

words.s: When the family moves to the US they will assimilate into American culture.
words.d: To assimilate is to adopt the ways of a new culture and fully become a part of it.

words.s: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
words.sz: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？
words.d: If something is ethical, it is the right thing to do.

t: 耕种， 耕作； 培养， 教育
吸毒成瘾的人， 有瘾的人， 对…入迷的人
words.s: He's a meth addict.
words.sz: 他是个吸毒男。
words.d: An addict is a person who cannot stop doing something.

t: 令人惊奇的； 奇特的， 非凡的； 奇迹般的， 不可思议的； 绝妙的
值得信赖的， 可靠的
words.s: Mary is one of the most trustworthy people I’ve ever met.
words.d: If someone is trustworthy, they are honest and truthful.

t: 可比较的， 类似的； 比得上的
受…支配的， 取决于…的； 易遭受…的
words.s: What subject do you think he is interested in?
words.sz: 你觉得他会对什么主题感兴趣？
words.d: To subject is to cause or force someone or something to experience something harmful or unpleasant.

t: 奖金， 红利； 好处
识别； 认出； 承认， 确认， 认可； 赏识， 表彰
words.s: She gave me a smile of recognition.
words.sz: 她給了我一個認可的微笑。
words.d: Recognition is the act of getting praise from other people.

t: 走廊， 通道； 侧廊
words.s: I'd like an aisle seat, please.
words.sz: 請給我靠走道的位子。
words.d: An aisle is a space between two things that people use to walk.

words.s: The new products really increased the business’s monthly revenue.
words.d: Revenue is the income made by a company.

t: 剥夺；夺去，使空无一物；拆卸，拆开
带状物； 条纹； 狭长地带， 带状水域
words.s: He had long strips of film that held images of his trip abroad.
words.d: A strip is a long, narrow piece of material or land.

t: 垄断， 专卖； 垄断商品， 专卖商品
words.s: Monopoly is a popular game for families to play.
words.sz: 大富翁是一個家庭玩的熱門遊戲。

words.s: Since you already know English, after learning French you’ll be bilingual.
words.d: A bilingual person can speak two languages.

t: 住宅， 住处； 居住

words.s: We yawn when we are short of oxygen.
words.sz: 我们缺氧时就会打哈欠。
words.d: Oxygen is a gas that all living things need to breathe.

words.s: I altered the color of my nails to match my hair.
words.d: To alter something means to change it.

words.s: Mina combined peanut butter and jelly to make a sandwich.
words.d: To combine is to join together to make a single thing or group.

t: 理想的，完美的；理想主义的；空想的；唯心的
words.s: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.
words.sz: 海滩是一个供孩子们玩乐的理想场所。
words.d: An ideal thing is the best that it can possibly be.

words.s: I can't find the broom.
words.sz: 我找不到掃把了。
words.d: A broom is a brush with a long handle used for cleaning floors.

words.s: Keep away from the electrical equipment.
words.sz: 遠離電器設備。
words.d: Equipment consists of the things which are used for a specific purpose.

t: 对…施加压力； 迫使， 说服
words.s: I'm under so much pressure, I just want to cry.
words.sz: 我壓力好大，我真想哭。
words.d: Pressure is what you apply to make someone do something.

t: 有文化； 有教养； 读写能力
喂养，为…提供食物；吃，以…为食
words.s: If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.
words.sz: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。

t: 起源， 发生； 首创， 创造
words.s: The idea of democracy originated in Ancient Greece.
words.d: To originate somewhere is to start there.

words.s: Compass needles point to the north.
words.sz: 指南针的指针指向北边。

t: 背景； 经历； 后台； 不重要或不引人注目的地方
words.s: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
words.sz: 图片的背景是一座城堡。
words.d: A background is a person’s education, family, and experience.

t: 宪法， 章程； 体质， 体格； 组成， 形成
words.s: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.
words.sz: 平等是由宪法保障的。
words.d: A constitution is a document of principles for a government.

t: 混合物； 混合， 交融
words.s: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.
words.sz: 將混合物攪拌均勻。
words.d: To blend is to mix two or more things together so that they become one thing.

t: 想出， 构想， 设想； 怀孕
words.s: I can't conceive of living without him.
words.sz: 我無法想像生命中沒有他。
words.d: To conceive something means to be able to imagine or believe it.

words.s: He had a red stain on the collar of his shirt.
words.d: A stain is a dirty mark that is difficult to clean.

t: 身体的，肉体的；物理的，物理学的；物质的，有形的
words.s: Biking is good for your physical health.
words.d: If something is physical, it is related to your body and not your mind.

t: 实现， 完成； 满足
橘子； 达官贵人， 官僚； [M-] 普通话
words.s: I cannot speak Mandarin well.
words.sz: 我的中文說得不好。
words.d: Mandarin is one of the two main Chinese languages.

t: 系统安排； 精心组织
words.s: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.
words.sz: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
words.d: The structure involves the shape and organization of the parts of a building or group.

t: 桩；火刑柱；利害关系；股份；
words.s: I felt that my honor was at stake.
words.sz: 我覺得我的名譽受到了威脅。
words.d: A stake is a small, sharp piece of wood or metal that is put into the ground.

t: 强烈， 剧烈； 强度

words.s: The woman was the only witness of the horrible crime.
words.d: A witness is someone who sees or hears a crime or accident happen.

t: 到期的， 预期的； 应有的， 应得的； 正当的
words.s: Ladies and gentlemen, due to an accident at the airport, our arrival will be delayed.
words.sz: 女士們，先生們，由於機場的意外情況，我們的著陸將被推遲。
words.d: When something is due, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

t: 遵守， 服从； 适应， 顺应； 相一致， 相符合
words.s: We must conform to the rules.
words.sz: 我们必须遵守规则。
words.d: To conform to rules or laws is to obey them.

t: 循环， 流通； 流传， 传播； 发行， 发行量
真品的， 真迹的； 真正的， 真实的， 逼真的
words.s: We ate authentic Italian food on our vacation to Rome.
words.d: When something is authentic, it is not false or a copy of the original.

t: 偶然性， 可能性； 意外事件； 附带事件

words.s: We should inform them about that.
words.sz: 我们应该把那件事情告知他们。
words.d: To inform someone is to tell them about something.

t: 依靠， 依赖； 信赖， 相信； 决定于， 视…而定
words.s: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
words.sz: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。
words.d: To depend on something is to need it for support or help.

t: 把…交托给， 提交； 犯， 干
words.s: Why do people commit suicide?
words.sz: 为什么人们会自杀?
words.d: To commit to something is to promise to do it.

t: 经验主义的， 以经验为依据的
words.s: Scientists must always find empirical evidence in their work.
words.d: Empirical means involving scientific proof and evidence.

words.s: No words can express her deep sorrow.
words.sz: 她的悲伤无法言喻。
words.d: Sorrow is a very sad feeling.

t: 路缘， 镶边石； 马勒； 起限制作用的事物
words.s: She curbed her anger by listening to a relaxing song.
words.d: To curb something means to prevent it from happening or increasing.

t: 碰撞；冲，闯；倒下，坠落；发出撞击声；垮台，破产
碰撞；坠落，坠毁；破裂声，撞击声
words.s: His wife is in the hospital because she was injured in a car crash.
words.sz: 他的妻子在醫院裡因為她在一場車禍中受傷了。
words.d: To crash means to hit and break something.

t: 降雨， 降水； 仓促， 急躁； 【化】 沉淀作用
性格， 品质； 性质， 特性； 人物， 角色； 符号， 字
words.s: Who's your favorite character in this book?
words.sz: 你最喜歡這本書中的哪個角色？
words.d: Your character is your personality.

t: 磁的， 有磁性的； 有吸引力的

words.s: My cholesterol is high.
words.sz: 我的胆固醇很高。
words.d: Cholesterol is a substance in fat, tissues, and blood of all animals.

t: 沿轨道运行； 围绕…运动
轨道；影响范围，势力范围
words.s: It takes 165 years for Neptune to orbit around the sun.
words.sz: 海王星繞行太陽一周要花一百六十五年。
words.d: To orbit something means to move around it in a continuous, curving path.

t: 乐队； 群， 伙； 带， 箍； 条纹； 波段， 频带
words.s: It'll be hard to find a good vocalist who isn't already working with another band.
words.sz: 很難找到一位沒有在其他樂團工作的優秀主唱。
words.d: A band is a group of people who play music.

words.s: Our school’s football team is mostly comprised with seniors.
words.d: If something comprises something else, it consists of or is made up of it.

words.s: The average height of girls in this class is over 155 centimeters.
words.sz: 这个班的女生平均身高超过了155公分。
words.d: Height is how tall someone or something is.

t: 减轻， 缓和； 使适中
words.s: Moderate exercise will refresh both mind and body.
words.sz: 适度的运动让身心焕然一新。
words.d: When something is moderate, it is not too big or too small in size or amount.

t: 模块； 模式； 舱； 组件； 单元

words.s: Where's the nearest shopping mall?
words.sz: 最近的大卖场在哪里？

t: 可观的， 大量的； 坚固的， 结实的； 实质的； 大体上的
words.s: The bank said that he owed it a substantial amount of money.
words.d: If something is substantial, then it is of great importance, size, or value.

t: 将…处死； 实施， 执行
words.s: We must execute his orders.
words.sz: 我们必须执行他的命令。
words.d: To execute means to kill someone as a legal punishment.

words.s: Being able to fly is a benefit to birds.
words.d: A benefit is a good thing.

t: 把…制成麦芽； 变成麦芽
words.s: Beer is taxed according to its malt content, so low-malt beer is cheaper.
words.sz: 因为啤酒会根据麦芽含量去征税，所以发泡酒会比较便宜。

t: 小房间； 公用电话亭； 售货棚
words.s: Tom ran and ran, until at last he saw the telephone booth.
words.sz: 湯姆跑啊跑,直到他終於看到了電話亭。

t: 唯一的， 独一无二的； 极不寻常的， 极好的
words.s: These flowers have a unique smell.
words.sz: 這些花有一種獨特的氣味。
words.d: A unique person or thing is not like others.

t: 使增长，使兴旺；鼓励，促进；为…作宣传，宣扬
增加， 提高； 帮助， 激励
words.s: Lowering prices boosts customers’ interest in shopping.
words.d: To boost something means to increase or improve it.

t: 真挚的， 诚挚的， 真诚的， 诚恳的
words.s: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
words.sz: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。
words.d: A sincere person is honest, especially about emotions or opinions.

words.s: The Ministry of Trade is responsible for taxing imports and exports.
words.d: A ministry is a government department.

words.s: Maternal love is greater than anything else.
words.sz: 母爱比任何别的东西都伟大。

words.s: Since he would not follow the rules, the principal had to expel the student.
words.d: To expel someone means to force them to leave a place.

words.s: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
words.sz: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。
words.d: A shelter is a place to go that is safe from danger or bad weather.

t: 检查； 调查， 研究； 测验
words.s: Dentists take X-rays to examine your teeth.
words.sz: 牙医用X光检查你的牙齿。
words.d: To examine something is to look at it carefully.

words.s: The device was able to tell the traveler his exact latitude.
words.d: The latitude of a place is its distance from the equator.

words.s: I applied for membership in the association.
words.sz: 我申請成為協會會員。

t: 消灭， 消除； 淘汰
words.s: Wearing a seatbelt eliminates some of the dangers of driving a car.
words.d: To eliminate something that is unwanted means to completely remove it.

t: 垃圾堆； 垃圾填筑地， 废渣埋填地
增加， 提高， 扩大
可辨认的， 可识别的； 可确定的， 可证明是同一的
破坏， 毁灭， 摧毁
words.s: The wildfires left the forest in a state of destruction.
words.d: To damage something is to cause its destruction.

words.s: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
words.sz: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。

t: 繁荣， 兴旺； 成功
words.s: Frank’s new business finally prospered after many years of hard work.
words.d: To prosper is to be successful or make a lot of money.

words.s: I'm sorry to bother you so often.
words.sz: 一直打扰你不好意思。
words.d: To bother is to make the effort to do something.

t: 更新， 恢复； 重新开始； 重建； 复兴； 续期； 重申
上诉， 申诉； 呼吁； 感染力， 吸引力
words.s: Between you and me, Tom's idea doesn't appeal to me very much.
words.sz: 汤姆的主意我不太感兴趣，这个我们之间说说就好。
words.d: To appeal to someone is to be interesting or attractive.

words.s: I don't mean to swamp you.
words.sz: 我不想把你淹死。
words.d: A swamp is a very wet area of land.

words.s: The entrepreneur made a success out of his new business.
words.d: An entrepreneur is someone who starts a new business or organization in order to make money.

t: 运输， 运输系统， 运输工具
words.s: I don’t have a car, so my normal transportation is the train.
words.d: Transportation is any type of vehicle that can carry people or things.

words.s: The nun dedicated herself to helping people in need.
words.d: To dedicate oneself to something means to put a lot of time and effort into it.

t: 出现， 显露， 公开露面； 出场， 问世； 仿佛， 似乎
words.s: The king will appear in person tomorrow evening.
words.sz: 国王明晚会亲自出现。
words.d: To appear is to seem.

t: 广大的， 广阔的； 广泛的
words.s: The game drew extensive media coverage.
words.d: Extensive means large in size or amount.

t: 居住的， 住宅的； 寄宿的

words.s: Tom tried to stab me.
words.sz: 湯姆企圖刺我。
words.d: To stab means to cut with the end of a sharp object like a knife.

t: 鼓舞， 激起； 给…以灵感
words.s: Jim’s father likes to inspire his son by encouraging him to follow his dream.
words.d: To inspire is to encourage someone by making them feel confident and eager to do something.

t: 给予， 赋予； 传授； 告知， 透露
合作， 协作； 勾结， 通敌
官僚主义； 官僚机构
words.s: The members of the bureaucracy were flooded by too many petitions.
words.d: A bureaucracy is a group of people who work together to help manage a large business or run a country.

t: 使合法； 赋予合法权利

words.s: If you want to be able to calculate the area of a circle, you must study geometry.
words.d: Geometry is the study of shapes and how to measure them.

words.s: When the wind is blowing, birds can glide easily through the sky.
words.d: To glide means to fly on extended wings with little or no effort.

t: 使劳累过分；对…使用过度；滥用
过重的工作； 工作过度
words.s: After working for three weeks with only one day of rest, Judy was overworked.
words.d: To overwork someone means to make them tired with too much work.

words.s: She devotes two hours a day to playing the piano.
words.d: To devote time to something means to spend a lot of time doing it.

t: 投资； 投入； 授予， 赋予
words.s: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
words.sz: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
words.d: To invest means to use money in a way that will bring a profit later.

words.s: My approximate height is two meters.
words.d: Approximate means close to an exact amount, number, or time.

t: 放映； 投射， 发射； 突出， 伸出； 设计， 规划
计划，方案；课题，项目；工程[prə'dʒekt]
words.s: The company invested a lot of money in this project.
words.sz: 該公司在這個企劃中投入了很多錢。
words.d: A project is a type of work that you do for school or a job.

t: 内地， 腹地， 内陆

words.s: The diameter of the tree was about 60 centimeters.
words.d: The diameter of a round thing is the length across its center.

t: 静止的， 不动的， 固定的； 稳定的

words.s: A dog will bark at strangers.
words.sz: 狗会对陌生人叫。
words.d: To bark is to make a short, loud noise, like a dog.

t: 成环， 成圈； 成环形运动
words.s: He made a loop with the rope and placed it over the post.
words.d: A loop is a line made into the shape of a circle.

words.s: It is not easy to catch a hare with your bare hands.
words.sz: 空手赤拳抓野兔並不容易。
words.d: A bare thing is plain and not covered.

t: 可怕的； 难以应付的， 难以克服的

words.s: Don't you want to see what I have in my suitcase?
words.sz: 你不想看我的行李箱裡有什麼嗎？

t: 吸盘； 吸根， 根出条

words.s: After the conquest, the people of the small city had no freedom.
words.d: A conquest is an event by which one country takes over another country.

words.s: I easily became lost in the dense forest.
words.d: If something is dense, it has a lot of things close together.

t: 信心； 保证； 保险

words.s: The loud crash disrupted the class lecture.
words.d: To disrupt something or someone is to prevent them from working.

t: 护目镜； 风镜； 游泳镜
假设的， 假定的； 爱猜想的

words.s: I got a farewell present from everyone.
words.sz: 每個人都送了我一份歡送禮物。
words.d: A farewell is an instance of saying goodbye or a way to say it.

words.s: Many homes have appliances like ovens, toasters, and refrigerators.
words.d: An appliance is a piece of equipment used for jobs in the home.

words.s: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
words.sz: 大量生產降低許多商品的價格。

t: [the R-] 文艺复兴， 文艺复兴时期； 复兴， 新生
words.s: Leonardo da Vinci was a popular artist of the Renaissance.
words.d: The Renaissance was a period between the 14th and 17th centuries.

t: 有毒的， 有害的； 恶毒的， 邪恶的
words.s: Is it poisonous?
words.sz: 它有毒嗎？

t: 承认； 准许…进入； 准许…加入
words.s: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
words.sz: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

t: 推进， 推动； 驱使
words.s: The strong wind propelled the leaf through the air and across the street.
words.d: To propel something means to push or move it somewhere.

t: 猖獗的， 肆虐的， 泛滥的； 蔓生的， 疯长的

words.s: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
words.sz: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。

words.d: A mechanism is a part of a machine that performs a certain function.

words.s: Should we use genetic engineering on people?
words.sz: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？
words.d: If something is genetic, it is related to the genes in one’s body.

words.s: I'm going to see a horror film.
words.sz: 我要去看恐怖電影。
words.d: Horror is a feeling of being very afraid or shocked.

words.s: The tip of the spear was dipped in a deadly poison.
words.sz: 矛尖浸在一種致命的毒藥裡。

t: 谆谆教诲， 反复灌输
说服， 劝说； 使相信
words.s: I had a hard time trying to persuade him to cancel the trip.
words.sz: 说服他中止旅行真是件苦差事。
words.d: To persuade someone is to make that person agree to do something.

words.s: The consensus among the children was that ghosts exist.
words.d: A consensus is a general agreement among a group of people.

t: 使失去方向感； 使迷茫， 使不知所措
完全的， 绝对的， 纯粹的
words.s: A computer is an absolute necessity now.
words.sz: 電腦現在是一個絕對必要的東西了。

t: 描述， 描写， 形容
words.s: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
words.sz: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？
words.d: To describe is to say or write what someone or something is like.

words.s: Anybody wanna grab something to eat with me?
words.sz: 有谁想一起去吃饭吗？
words.d: To grab is to take a hold of someone or something suddenly.

words.s: Tom lives in a slum.
words.sz: 汤姆住在贫民窟里。

t: 富的， 富裕的； 充裕的
words.s: If it had not been for civil war, they would be wealthy now.
words.sz: 要不是当初有内战，他们现在应该挺富裕了。

t: 可通航的； 适于航行的

words.s: She hoped she could be promoted to a job in administration.
words.d: An administration is the group of people who manage a company or organization.

words.s: Before he was a successful writer, Mark Twain dwelled in the city of Hannibal, Missouri.
words.d: To dwell somewhere means to live there.

t: 把…合并， 纳入； 包含， 吸收
words.s: I decided to incorporate a new ingredient into my cake recipe.
words.d: To incorporate is to add something to another thing.

words.s: We all became tired of listening to him boast about himself all day.
words.d: To boast is to talk about how great one is.

t: 提神物； 帮助记忆的东西或人； 补习课程
重复， 反复； 反复地说， 重申

words.s: A few years ago, our room had little furniture in it.
words.sz: 幾年前，我們的房間裡沒有什麼家具。
words.d: Furniture means the things used in a house such as tables and chairs.

t: 与对方地位相当的人； 配对物； 副本
words.s: Our manager will meet our rival company’s counterpart later today.
words.d: A counterpart is something that is very similar to something else in what it does.

t: 不吉祥的， 凶兆的； 险恶的， 邪恶的
words.s: Bad guys in most movies have sinister laughs.
words.d: If something or someone is sinister, they are evil.

t: 片段； 部分； 节； 线段； 瓣

words.s: The flag of the United States has red and white stripes.
words.d: A stripe is a thick line.

words.s: I imagine that you are wondering when your new PC will arrive.
words.sz: 我猜您一定想知道您的新電腦什麼時候到貨。
words.d: To imagine something is to think of it in your mind.

t: 吸引的， 有吸引力的； 引起注意的
words.s: Mary has as attractive a personality as her sister.
words.sz: 玛丽性格很好，就像她姐姐一样。

t: 提供饮食； 迎合； 满足需要
words.s: Bill was too sick to get out of bed, so his nurse catered to his needs.
words.d: To cater to someone means to provide them with all the things they need or want.

words.s: She duplicated her friend’s movements like she was in front of a mirror.
words.d: To duplicate something means to copy it.

words.s: This medicine will decrease your pain.
words.sz: 这种药会减轻你的疼痛。
words.d: To decrease something is to make it less than it was before.

t: 振， 拍打； 飘动， 晃动； 跳动
无知， 愚昧； 不知道
words.s: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
words.sz: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。
words.d: Ignorance of something is lack of knowledge about it.

t: 发芽， 生长； 发展

words.s: Many birds migrate to warmer countries in the winter.
words.d: To migrate means to move from one place to another.

t: 占用， 占领； 忙碌于； 从事
words.s: Kevin and Alice occupied the chairs and had a long discussion.
words.d: To occupy a place is to live, work, or be there.

t: 缚； 扎； 挂； 串起； 使排成一列
words.s: A string of disasters struck the region.
words.sz: 一連串的災難襲擊這個地區。
words.d: String is a thin piece of fabric or rope.

words.s: People in the city are usually more affluent than people in the country.
words.d: If someone is affluent, they are wealthy.

t: 简单， 简易； 朴素； 直率， 单纯
words.s: We were able to find the house thanks to the simplicity of the directions.
words.d: The simplicity of something is the fact that it is easy to do or understand.

words.s: Snow covered the summit of the mountain even during the summer.
words.d: A summit is the highest part of a hill or mountain.

words.s: Astronomers use telescopes to magnify faraway stars.
words.d: To magnify something means to make it look bigger than it really is.

t: 被解雇的； 多余的， 过剩的； 累赘的， 冗长的
法律规定的； 既定的
结论， 推论； 结束， 结尾； 【法】 缔结， 议定
words.s: Tom came to the conclusion that no matter what he did, Mary wouldn't like it.
words.sz: 汤姆得出无论他做什么，玛丽都不会喜欢的结论。
words.d: The conclusion of something is the final part of it.

t: 把…强加于； 征； 处以
words.s: He imposes on his wife every morning by expecting her to make his breakfast.
words.d: To impose means to interrupt or force your ideas on other people.

words.s: A dolphin is a kind of mammal.
words.sz: 海豚是一種哺乳動物。
words.d: A mammal is an animal that usually has hair and is not born from an egg.

t: 陈述； 声明； 报表
words.s: I would like to retract my previous statement.
words.sz: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。

t: 投递， 交付； 分娩
征服， 战胜， 占领； 克服， 破除
words.s: The soldiers were trying to conquer the world.
words.d: To conquer a place means to attack and take control of it.

t: 操纵别人的； 老于世故的
给…上蜡， 给…打蜡； 渐圆， 渐满
words.s: The candles are made of wax.
words.d: Wax is a substance that is slightly shiny and melts when heated.

t: 感觉能力； 感觉， 知觉； 轰动， 引起轰动的事件
words.s: Mom got a painful sensation in her head from the loud noise.
words.d: A sensation is a feeling that people get from their senses.

t: 都市的； 住在都市的
words.s: More and more people are moving to urban areas.
words.sz: 越來越多的人遷往市區。
words.d: If something is urban, it is related to towns and cities.

t: 参考， 查阅， 查询； 提到， 谈及； 引用； 提交， 上呈
words.s: Mr. Cid referred to the time to show Bill that he was late for class.
words.d: To refer to something means to mention or call attention to it.

words.s: Sulfur burns with a blue flame.
words.sz: 硫磺燃燒著藍色的火焰。
words.d: A flame is part of a fire.

words.s: After repairing the window, discard any broken glass.
words.d: To discard something is to throw it away.

words.s: The official gave the company a subsidy so it could open two new factories.
words.d: A subsidy is money given by the government to companies to assist them.

t: 淫秽的， 猥亵的， 下流的； 可憎的， 可恶的； 大得惊人的， 骇人听闻的
禁止的， 抑制的； 令人望而却步的
注意的， 专心的； 关心的， 体贴的； 留意的
垂死的， 即将灭亡的； 即将结束的
碾碎； 压服， 压垮； 镇压， 制服； 压碎， 压坏
words.s: It looks like Tom has a crush on Mary.
words.sz: 看来汤姆热恋着玛丽。
words.d: To crush something is to press it together so its shape is destroyed.

t: 把…嵌入， 扎牢； 使深留脑中
有希望的； 有前途的
words.s: He is a promising student.
words.sz: 他是一位有前途的学生。

t: 律师，法律顾问；建议，忠告
生活者， 居住者； 肝脏
words.s: The professor showed us what the human liver looks like.
words.d: The liver is a large organ in the body that produces bile and cleans blood.

t: 不锈的； 无污点的， 无瑕疵的
结果的， 随之发生的
流行， 盛行； 占优势， 战胜
words.s: Justice will prevail in the end.
words.sz: 正义终将胜利。
words.d: To prevail means to be accepted or very common.

t: 使减到最低限度； 最小化
嫩叶， 嫩芽； 吃草； 浏览

words.s: I only ate a small portion of the pizza.
words.d: A portion of something is a part of it.

t: 无效的， 无用的， 无意义的； 没出息的； 琐细的
使全神贯注， 占去全部注意力和时间
使混乱， 混淆； 使迷惑， 使糊涂
words.s: Don't confuse desire with love.
words.sz: 不要把欲望和爱情混为一谈。
words.d: To confuse someone means to make them feel like they are unsure.

words.s: The storm didn't abate for several hours.
words.sz: 风暴几个小时没有减弱了。

words.s: They both cried after hearing the tragic news.
words.sz: 聽到這件悲劇，他倆盡皆哭泣。
words.d: A tragic event causes sadness because it might involve death or suffering.

words.s: The physician prescribed his patient some medicine.
words.sz: 医生给他的病人开了一些药。
words.d: A physician is a doctor.

words.s: This will be a good souvenir of my trip around the United States.
words.sz: 这将是我环绕美国旅行中一个很好的纪念品。
words.d: A souvenir is something bought to remember of a place or event.

words.s: That joke makes me grin every time I hear it.
words.d: To grin means to smile broadly.

t: 握紧，抓牢；吸引住…的注意力
紧握， 抓牢； 掌握， 控制
words.s: Get a grip on yourself.
words.sz: 冷静下来！
words.d: To grip something is to hold it very tightly.

t: 探险， 探索； 仔细检查， 探究
words.s: He wants to explore the world and see new things.
words.d: To explore is to look for new places.

t: 气候； 风气， 思潮
words.s: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
words.sz: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。
words.d: A climate is the usual weather in a place.

t: 硬层， 硬表面， 地壳； 面包皮
words.s: The little boy never ate the crust of his pizza.
words.d: Crust is the tough outer part of a loaf of bread.

t: 格子， 栅格； 地图上的坐标方格； 输电网， 煤气输送网
words.s: We located our town using the grid.
words.d: A grid is a pattern of squares with numbers and letters to find places on a map.

words.s: Tom wanted to become a veterinarian.
words.sz: 那时汤姆相当一个兽医。
words.d: A veterinarian is a doctor who takes care of animals.

t: 经济的； 经济上的， 经济学的
words.s: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
words.sz: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

words.s: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
words.sz: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。
words.d: A board is a flat piece of wood.

t: 严厉的； 可怕的； 讨厌的
words.s: The boy made the grim discovery that he had accidentally deleted his homework.
words.d: Something that is grim is worrying, serious, and scary.

t: 统计数字， 统计资料； 统计学
words.s: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.
words.sz: 事实是倔强的，但统计是柔顺的。

words.s: Can't you move your stuff to the other room?
words.sz: 你不能把你的东西搬去另一个房间吗？
words.d: Stuff is a word used to refer to things without mentioning the things by name.

t: 子女， 后代； 产物
words.s: The dog’s offspring had the same color of fur as she did.
words.d: Offspring are the children of a person or the babies of an animal.

t: 部分； 部门； 截面
words.s: There are seven men and four women in my section.
words.sz: 在我的部门里有七男四女。

words.s: He is constantly finding fault with other people.
words.sz: 他总是挑别人的毛病。
words.d: Constantly means doing something on a continuous basis.

t: 威胁， 恐吓； 预示快要来临， 是…的征兆， 可能发生
words.s: Did Tom ever threaten you?
words.sz: 湯姆威脅過你嗎？

t: 充实， 使丰富； 使富裕
words.s: Taxes on people’s income can be used to enrich the government.
words.d: To enrich means to make someone rich or increase their wealth.

t: 拉紧， 绷紧； 扭伤， 拉伤； 过劳， 极度紧张
words.s: Tom has been under a great deal of strain lately.
words.sz: 汤姆最近压力特别大。
words.d: To strain is to try very hard.

t: 另样，用别的方法；在其他方面
words.s: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late for lunch.
words.sz: 快点，不然你吃午饭就要迟到了。
words.d: Otherwise means in another way if you don’t do this.

t: 可见的， 看得见的； 有形的； 明显的， 显而易见的
words.s: Tom rolled up his trouser legs, making his bright red socks visible.
words.sz: 湯姆捲起褲管，露出鮮紅的襪子。

t: 密谋，施诡计；引起极大兴趣，迷住['ɪntrɪːg]
阴谋， 诡计； 密谋
words.s: Her mysterious past intrigued her new friend.
words.d: To intrigue means to cause an interest in something or someone.

t: 旅行， 航行， 飞行
words.s: Mary went on a voyage around the world.
words.sz: 玛丽去环游世界了。
words.d: A voyage is a long journey made on a boat or an aircraft.

t: 热衷的， 热心的， 渴望的； 敏锐的， 敏捷的； 激烈的， 紧张的； 锋利的
words.s: Dogs have a keen sense of smell.
words.sz: 狗的嗅觉灵敏。
words.d: If someone is keen, they are intelligent.

words.s: The mother always made sure that her baby had good nutrition.
words.d: Nutrition is the process of eating the right kind of food in order to stay healthy.

t: 谷类植物； 谷物； 谷类食物
words.s: Cereal is a fast and common breakfast food enjoyed in the US.
words.d: Cereal is a breakfast food made from grains that is eaten with milk.

words.s: Lots of people in Japan are indifferent to politics.
words.sz: 很多日本人對政治冷淡。
words.d: When someone is indifferent toward something, they have a lack of interest in it.

t: 使产生， 招致； 实现
words.s: Don't worry! Even if I drink, it doesn't have an effect on my driving.
words.sz: 別擔心!即使我喝酒了,它對我的駕駛沒有影響。
words.d: An effect is a change made by something else.

t: 庄严的， 隆重的； 严肃的， 认真的
words.s: The professor preferred a solemn relationship between him and his students.
words.d: If something is solemn, then it is serious and honest.

words.s: The camper inhaled the cool and fresh mountain air and felt relaxed.
words.d: To inhale means to take air or a smell into the lungs.

t: 感知， 察觉； 认识到， 理解
words.s: He was talking loudly, so he did not perceive that the music had stopped.
words.d: To perceive something means to be aware of it.

t: 选择； 选择的物； 选课
words.s: What other option is there?
words.sz: 還有其他選擇嗎？
words.d: An option is a choice between two or more things.

t: 称重； 认真考虑， 权衡
words.s: Can you weigh this, please?
words.sz: 請你稱一下這個的重量好嗎？
words.d: To weigh something means to measure how heavy it is.

t: 灵敏的； 剧烈的， 猛烈的
words.s: When she fell out of the tree, the girl felt an acute pain in her arm.
words.d: When a bad thing is acute, it is very severe and intense.

words.s: A little bit of luck sometimes leads to an unexpected success.
words.sz: 一點點的運氣有時會導致意想不到的成功。

t: 决定性的； 至关重要的
words.s: This is a crucial point.
words.sz: 这是一个关键点。
words.d: If something is crucial, it is extremely important to another thing.

t: 揭去面纱或覆盖物； 揭幕； 首次公开、 揭露或展示
捐赠， 捐助； 起作用， 影响
words.s: We decided to contribute money to the new hospital.
words.d: To contribute to something means to do something to make it successful.

t: 信任， 信用； 信仰， 信条
words.s: I have absolute faith in you.
words.sz: 我百分之百相信你。
words.d: Faith is trust or belief without proof.

words.s: The teacher remarked on how quickly the students were learning.
words.d: To remark is to say something.

t: 懒惰的， 邋遢的； 放荡的

words.s: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
words.sz: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？
words.d: A microscope is a device that makes small objects look bigger.

words.s: Large houses are not necessarily comfortable to live in.
words.sz: 大房子不一定适合住。

t: 候选人， 候补者； 申请求职者； 报考者
words.s: He was the strongest candidate for the position.
words.sz: 他是那个职位最有希望的候选人。
words.d: A candidate is a person who is competing to win something such as a job.

t: 可理解的， 明白易懂的， 清楚的
平行的；类似的，相对应的；并行的
可相比拟的事物，相似处；纬线
words.s: The opposite sides of a parallelogram are parallel.
words.sz: 平行四边形的对边平行。
words.d: If two things are parallel, they are the same distance away from each other (along their entire length).

t: 友好款待， 好客； 盛情； 招待礼节
words.s: All the guests were touched by her hospitality.
words.sz: 所有的客人都被她的好客感动了。
words.d: Hospitality is friendly behavior and entertainment, shown to guests or strangers.

t: 水运的， 水传播的， 饮水传染的

words.s: Having a lot of money is a stimulus for people to buy more things.
words.d: A stimulus is something that causes growth or activity.

t: 终点，终端；终点站，航站楼
words.s: Since his condition was not terminal, he felt a great sense of relief.
words.d: If something is terminal, then it causes or results in death.

t: 减少； 降低； 贬低， 轻视
words.s: As the economy got worse, my savings diminished.
words.d: To diminish means to reduce or get smaller.

t: 超过， 超越， 优于， 胜过； 超过…的界限， 非…所能办到

words.s: I work as an administrative assistant to the owner of the company.
words.d: Administrative describes anything related to managing a company or organization.

t: 各种各样的； 不同的； 多方面的
words.s: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
words.sz: 日本從國外進口各種原料。
words.d: If something is various, there are many types of it.

t: 注意， 留心； 立正
words.s: A growing child who doesn't seem to have much energy perhaps needs medical attention.
words.sz: 一个成长中的孩子如果没有充足的能量，可能需要药物治疗。
words.d: Attention is the notice, thought, or consideration of someone.

t: 屈服， 屈从； 死亡
范围； 面积； 广度， 长度； 程度
words.s: I agree with what you say to some extent.
words.sz: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。
words.d: The extent of something is how large, important, or serious it is.

t: 相互关联， 相互影响
假定， 假设； 担任， 承担
words.s: That's a pretty big assumption.
words.sz: 假設得很大。

t: 养老金， 抚恤金； 年金

words.s: The man got to the rank of captain in the navy.
words.d: A rank is a person’s place in an order of people.

t: 忽视； 疏忽； 遗漏
words.s: William neglected his room, so it is a complete mess.
words.d: To neglect someone or something is to not take care of it properly.

words.s: In addition to English, he speaks German.
words.sz: 除了英文，他還說德文。

words.s: The students went to the beach to surf during their vacation.
words.d: To surf means to use a special board to ride on waves in the ocean.

words.s: The gang was planning a robbery.
words.sz: 這夥人計劃搶劫。

words.s: My father usually carves the turkey for Thanksgiving.
words.d: To carve means to cut into something.

t: 领导层； 层次， 等级
words.s: Everyone knows where they fit in the hierarchy.
words.d: A hierarchy is a system of things or people ranked one above the other.

words.s: The blue textile was going to be used to make blouses.
words.d: Textile is cloth that has been woven or knitted.

words.s: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
words.sz: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。
words.d: Former describes something that used to be but is not anymore.

words.s: There was widespread panic after the earthquake.
words.sz: 地震後人們普遍覺得恐慌。

words.s: I'd like to reserve a room in a hotel.
words.sz: 我想要订房。
words.d: To reserve something means to keep it for a certain person or time.

words.s: After the building was torn down, all that was left was a heap of bricks.
words.d: A heap of things is a large pile of them.

t: 同情； 赞同， 支持
words.s: Everybody showed sympathy toward the prisoner.
words.sz: 每个人都对囚犯表示同情。
words.d: Sympathy is a feeling of sadness for another person who feels bad.

words.s: I'm going to help you rescue Tom.
words.sz: 我要幫你營救湯姆。
words.d: To rescue someone means to remove them from danger.

t: 短时间的，短暂的；简短的，
words.s: The lawyers took a brief break.
words.d: A brief action lasts a short time.

t: 重新获得， 重新得到； 使复原， 使康复； 收回， 换回
words.s: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?
words.sz: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？

t: 确定； 决定； 下决心
words.s: When people meet, first impressions determine more than 50 percent of whatever happens next.
words.sz: 在人际交往中，第一印象决定着将要发生的事情内容的百分之五十以上。

t: 破坏， 毁坏； 使震惊， 使极为悲痛
words.s: The entire wall was devastated.
words.d: To devastate something is to cause great damage or pain to that thing.

t: 摩擦； 矛盾， 冲突

words.s: He is not as intelligent as his older brother.
words.sz: 他不像他的兄长那样聪明。
words.d: If someone is intelligent, they are very smart.

t: 装备， 配备； 使有能力， 使有准备
words.s: Steve was equipped with the tools needed to do the job.
words.d: To equip someone is to give them the things needed to do something.

words.s: Our honeymoon resort was a luxury we really enjoyed.
words.d: A luxury is an expensive thing that is nice but not needed.

t: 精神的； 心灵的； 宗教的
改变； 变化， 变形， 变质
壮观的， 壮丽的， 极好的； 堂皇的， 豪华的； 灿烂的， 辉煌的
words.s: From his head down to his shoes, his clothes looked splendid.
words.d: If something or someone is splendid, then they are very good.

t: 适应； 改编； 改制物

words.s: I love the convenience of having a swimming pool in my back yard.
words.d: If something is done for your convenience, it allows you to do something easily or without any trouble.

words.s: One of the teacher’s jobs is to teach her students discipline.
words.d: Discipline is training that helps people follow the rules.

t: 估计， 估量； 估价； 评价
words.s: How much time do you estimate it'll take you to do that?
words.sz: 你估计做那件事需要花费你多少时间呢？
words.d: To estimate something means to make a guess about it.

t: 毕业文凭； 资格证书
words.s: After four years of college, Mary finally had a diploma.
words.d: A diploma is a certificate proving that someone has completed their studies.

t: 铭刻， 打烙印于； 丑化
words.s: It's brand new.
words.sz: 这是全新的。

t: 提议， 建议； 求婚
words.s: I can't think of any other way of getting him to accept our proposal.
words.sz: 我看不出有其他方法能让他接受我们的提议。

t: 不可避免的， 必然的
words.s: Their meeting was inevitable.
words.sz: 他們的相遇是必然的。
words.d: When something is inevitable, it is certain to happen or cannot be avoided.

t: 振动的； 活泼的， 充满生气的； 兴奋的

words.s: Burj Khalifa is currently the tallest skyscraper in the world.
words.sz: 目前哈里發塔是世界上最高的摩天大樓。

t: 津贴； 允许， 容忍
便于携带的； 手提式的

words.s: Rome has a lot of ancient buildings.
words.sz: 罗马有很多古建筑。
words.d: If something is ancient, it is very old.

t: 徘徊， 闲逛， 漫步； 偏离正道； 走神， 恍惚
words.s: The boys like to wander in the woods and look at birds.
words.d: To wander is to walk without going to a certain place.

t: 采用， 采取， 采纳； 收养， 领养； 正式通过， 批准
words.s: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.
words.sz: 如果你不能有孩子，你总能领养。

words.s: I want to be a police officer because I oppose crime.
words.d: To oppose something means to dislike it or act against it.

t: 装置， 设备， 仪表； 方法； 设计； 手段， 策略
words.s: You should have shown him the device.
words.sz: 你应该给他看看这装置。
words.d: A device is an object or a machine.

t: 实况报道， 现场解说； 注释， 解释； 批评； 评价

words.s: On the whole, the Japanese are conservative.
words.sz: 总体上说，日本人很保守。

words.s: Please attend the meeting in the second floor conference room at 2:30 p.m.
words.sz: 请在两点半参加在二楼会议室的会议。

words.s: Turn the knob and open the door.
words.sz: 轉動門把，把門打開。

t: 寻找； 探索； 追求
words.s: You need to seek help.
words.sz: 你需要尋求協助。
words.d: To seek is to look for something.

t: 品种， 种类； 变化， 多样化
words.s: We talked about a variety of topics.
words.sz: 我們談了各種話題。
words.d: A variety of something is a group of many different kinds of it.

t: 扰乱； 弄乱， 打乱； 打扰， 使烦恼
words.s: I'll try not to disturb you while you're studying.
words.sz: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。
words.d: To disturb someone means to upset that person.

words.s: It is not necessary for us to attend this lecture.
words.sz: 我們沒有必要出席這個講座。
words.d: A lecture is a long, educational speech.

t: 坚持； 维持， 保持， 持续
words.s: Even though the lesson was difficult, he persisted until he understood.
words.d: To persist means to keep doing something even when it is hard.

words.s: Please use the power saw with caution. It is very dangerous.
words.d: Caution is care and attention in order to avoid danger.

words.s: Apart from on rainy days, I always ride my bike to work.
words.sz: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。
words.d: When people or things are apart, they are not next to each other.

t: 日历； 月历； 日程表
words.s: She hung the calendar on the wall.
words.sz: 她把日曆掛在牆上了。
words.d: A calendar is a chart that shows the days, weeks, and months of a year.

words.s: Tom is just an intern.
words.sz: 湯姆只不過是實習生。

t: 正义的， 正直的； 公正的； 正当的
欢跃， 跳跃； 嬉戏

words.s: My sister looked at the sky and speculated that it would rain tomorrow.
words.d: To speculate means to guess about something.

t: 幻灭； 觉醒， 醒悟
拆除； 废除， 取消
怪物； 巨人， 庞然大物
words.s: A huge monster is coming down the mountain.
words.sz: 从山上走来一只巨大的怪物。

t: 协力合作， 团队合作； 配合
标定， 划分； 校准刻度

words.s: Nancy acquainted herself with the new computer.
words.d: To acquaint is to get to know something or someone.

words.s: He attached the elastic bungee to his legs before he jumped of the platform.
words.d: Elastic is a rubber that stretches when it is pulled.

t: 帮助， 援助， 协助
words.s: I'll be able to assist you.
words.sz: 我能協助你。
words.d: To assist someone is to help them.

t: 作为结果的； 随之发生的
words.s: Her consequent rash came after she touched the poisonous plant.
words.d: Consequent means happening because of a different situation.

t: 大学本科生， 大学生， 大学肄业生
words.s: She was excited to finish high school and enroll as an undergraduate in the fall.
words.d: An undergraduate is a student at a college who is studying for a bachelor’s degree.

words.s: The doctor gave me a shot of an antibiotic when I got the flu.
words.d: An antibiotic is a medical drug used to kill bacteria and treat infections.

t: 商业的，商品化的，贸易的

words.s: Mike and Joanna are joint owners of a coffee shop.
words.d: When something is joint, it is done by or involves two or more people or groups.

t: 使分离， 使分开； 划分， 区分； 分离， 分开； 分居
分离的， 分开的； 不同的， 特别的
words.s: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.
words.sz: 他们分房睡，即使他们已经结婚了。
words.d: If two things are separate, they are not together.

t: 合理的， 有道理的； 通情达理的； 适度的
words.s: Tom bought this camera for a reasonable price.
words.sz: Tom用合理的價格買了相機。

words.s: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone would be willing to help me.
words.sz: 我知道不太可能有人願意幫助我。

t: 无秩序的， 无计划的， 组织混乱的
无价值的， 琐屑的； 平庸的， 普通的
words.s: This isn't a trivial matter.
words.sz: 這不是雞毛蒜皮的事。

words.s: The Japanese military forces seemed too strong to stop.
words.sz: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。
words.d: The military is the armed forces of a country.

t: 不情愿的， 勉强的； 难得到的， 难处理的
words.s: She was reluctant to say that she saw the robbery.
words.d: Reluctant means not wanting to do something.

t: 放弃， 抛弃； 作罢
确保， 保证； 担保； 赋予
words.s: Saving now will ensure we have enough money for our retirement.
words.d: When you ensure something, you make sure it happens.

words.s: We studied the organism under the microscope.
words.d: An organism is a living thing, especially a very small one.

words.s: It was difficult to stop the flu epidemic.
words.d: An epidemic is an outbreak of a disease that spreads quickly.

t: 假想， 假定， 猜想， 推测； [用于祈使句]假定， 让； [常用于被动语态]期望做， 认为应该做
words.s: Suppose you had a thousand dollars, what would you do with it?
words.sz: 假如你有1000美元，你会用它做什么呢？
words.d: To suppose is to guess.

t: 引人注目的， 显著的， 值得注意的； 异常的， 非凡的
words.s: In recent years, science has made remarkable progress.
words.sz: 这几年，科学取得了显著的进步。

t: 大臣； 总理； 首席法官； 大学校长

words.s: The dentist extracted the woman’s damaged tooth and put in a fake one.
words.d: To extract something means to remove it.

words.s: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.
words.sz: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。
words.d: To solve something is to find an answer to it.

t: 营养的， 滋养的； 营养物的， 食物的

words.s: A string of disasters struck the region.
words.sz: 一連串的災難襲擊這個地區。
words.d: A region is a large area of land usually based on some common feature.

words.s: She was only frightened, not injured.
words.sz: 她只是被嚇到了並沒有受傷。

words.s: It's wrong to deceive people, but worse to deceive yourself.
words.sz: 欺騙別人是錯的,但更糟的欺騙自己。
words.d: To deceive is to make someone believe something that is not true.

t: 人口， 全体居民； 平民， 大众
快餐， 小吃； 点心
words.s: What does Tom eat for a mid-afternoon snack?
words.sz: 湯姆下午茶點心都吃什麼？

t: 两栖的； 水陆两用的
目的地， 终点； 目标
words.s: They made straight for their destination.
words.sz: 他們直奔目的地。
words.d: A destination is the place where someone or something is going.

t: 隐私， 私事； 隐私权
words.s: Reporters do not hesitate to intrude into people's privacy.
words.sz: 记者没有犹豫地去干涉了人们的私生活。
words.d: Privacy is the state of being happily away from other people.

t: 令人泄气的， 使人沮丧的
使潮湿； 减弱， 抑制； 沮丧
words.s: The weather was not only cold, it was also damp.
words.sz: 天气又冷又湿。

words.s: The princess was the heir to the king and queen’s throne.
words.d: An heir is a person who receives the money or property of someone who dies.

words.s: I want to emphasize this point in particular.
words.sz: 我想特别强调这一点。

words.s: I'm not the only one who thinks Tom is overweight.
words.sz: 觉得汤姆肥的人不止我一个。
words.d: Overweight people or animals are heavier than is healthy.

words.s: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.
words.sz: 你不介意我关窗吧？我有点着凉了。
words.d: If something is slight, then it is small or minor.

t: 以前的； 在…之前的； 早先的， 稍前的
words.s: I would like to retract my previous statement.
words.sz: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。
words.d: If something is previous, then it happened earlier in time or order.

words.s: Tom and Mary argue with each other all the time.
words.sz: 汤姆和玛丽无时无刻不在辩论。

t: 拱廊， 有拱廊的街道
家谱； 门第； 血统
上级的，较高的；优越的，优于…的，较…多的；优良的，卓越的；有优越感的，高傲的
words.s: This carpet is superior to that one in quality.
words.sz: 這地毯在質量上比那箇好得多。
words.d: A superior person or thing is better than another.

words.s: We take it for granted that he will succeed in his business.
words.sz: 我们认为他的生意理所当然会获得成功。
words.d: To succeed is to complete something as planned.

t: 位置， 场所； 外景拍摄地
words.s: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
words.sz: 那個地點的書店無法賺足夠的錢生存下去。

t: 补偿， 赔偿； 赔偿物， 赔偿金

words.s: The store sold colorful accessories like bags, sunglasses, and makeup.
words.d: An accessory is a thing that is added to another thing to make it look better.

words.s: The company's going to go bankrupt really soon.
words.sz: 公司很快就要倒闭了。
words.d: If someone is bankrupt, then they are unable to pay their debts.

t: 痛苦，折磨；令人痛苦的东西[tɔː'ment]
折磨， 使痛苦， 烦扰； 纠缠； 戏弄， 捉弄
words.s: She tormented her little brother by taking his favorite toy.
words.d: To torment someone means to cause them to suffer on purpose.

words.s: How was the seminar?
words.sz: 研討會怎麼樣？

words.s: I participated in a photography competition.
words.sz: 我參加了一個攝影比賽。

t: 多产的， 富饶的； 富有成效的
在…较远的一边； 超出， 除…之外
words.s: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
words.sz: 你看過富士山嗎?它美得無法形容。
words.d: Beyond is used to say that one thing is more than another.

words.s: Smoking cigarettes poses many health hazards.
words.d: A hazard is something that could be dangerous to a person’s health or safety.

words.s: Many people attended the voluntary boat safety class.
words.d: When something is voluntary, it is done by choice but is not required.

words.s: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
words.sz: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。

words.s: They used his fingerprint for proof that he committed the crime.
words.d: Proof is a fact that shows something is real.

t: 好斗的人， 激进分子
words.s: The woman delivered an angry, militant speech on the floor of the legislature.
words.d: If someone is militant, they are angry and aggressive, and willing to fight easily.

t: 出席； 存在； 仪态
words.s: I told you not to talk about the matter in her presence.
words.sz: 我跟你说过她在的时候不要说这件事。
words.d: Presence is when someone or something is present in a particular place.

words.s: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.
words.sz: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。
words.d: A contract is a written agreement between two people.

t: 有利可图的， 赚钱的； 有益的
words.s: We'll be profitable this year.
words.sz: 今年我们会盈利的。

words.s: I saw crumbs on my dog’s face, so I concluded that he ate my cookie.
words.d: To conclude is to arrive at a logical end by looking at evidence.

t: 易受影响的， 易受伤害的； 易受感染的； 敏感的， 易动感情的； 能经受…的， 容许…的
words.s: She was susceptible to colds.
words.sz: 她易患感冒。
words.d: If one is susceptible to something like a disease, they are easily harmed by it.

words.s: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
words.sz: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
words.d: Leather is a material made from animal skin that is used to make clothing.

t: 梳理； 搜寻， 彻底搜查
words.s: Comb your hair before you go out.
words.sz: 在你出門之前，把你的頭髮梳一梳。

words.s: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.
words.sz: 你活着，但是却不知道为什么活着。
words.d: To exist is to be real.

t: 革新的， 创新的， 新颖的； 富有革新精神的
words.s: Since Peter was so innovative, he was chosen to lead the science team.
words.d: If something or someone is innovative, they can think in creative ways.

t: 洞察力， 深刻的了解； 顿悟
words.s: The physics textbook gave the student a new insight about gravity.
words.d: Insight is a deep and accurate understanding of something.

t: 有帮助的， 起作用的； 用乐器演奏的
words.s: I like instrumental music.
words.sz: 我喜歡器樂。

words.s: Can you explain the exact meaning of this word?
words.sz: 你能否說出這個詞的精確意思?
words.d: Exact means correct in every detail.

words.s: The unemployment rate in Japan was 3.4 percent in September of 2015.
words.sz: 在2015年9月日本的失业率为3.4％。

words.s: I will never force you to marry him.
words.sz: 我永遠不會逼你跟他結婚。
words.d: Force is a person’s strength or power.

t: 百分度的； 摄氏度的
words.s: Water freezes at 0 degrees Centigrade.
words.sz: 水在攝氏0度時結成冰。
words.d: If a temperature is given in centigrade, it is the same as the temperature in Celsius.

t: 分发， 分配； 配给物； 散布， 分布
需要久坐的； 惯于久坐不动的； 定居的， 不迁徙的； 沉积的
容量， 容积； 能量， 能力
words.s: The room has a seating capacity of 200.
words.sz: 这个房间能容纳200人。
words.d: The capacity of something is the amount of things that can be put in it.

words.s: After Tom lost his job, he started to gamble to cope with his depression.
words.sz: 湯姆失業後，為了排遣鬱悶的心情而開始了賭博。
words.d: To cope with a difficult or stressful situation means to deal with it.

t: 不可逃避的； 难免的
抄本， 副本； 文字记录
使湿透， 浸透； 使充满， 使饱和
words.s: The sponge was saturated with soapy water and dripped all over the floor.
words.d: To saturate something means to completely soak it with a liquid.

t: 追猎； 运行； 流动
过程，进程；路线，方针；跑道；课程
words.s: A cooking course should be mandatory in schools.
words.sz: 烹饪课程应该作为学校的必修课。
words.d: A course is a class in school.

words.s: This watch is waterproof.
words.sz: 這手錶是防水的。

t: 精确的， 准确的； 严谨的
words.s: The precise time of their arrival is not known.
words.sz: 他們到達的確切時間還不明。
words.d: If someone is precise, then they are exact and careful about their work.

t: 明智的； 合情理的； 能觉察到的
words.s: It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
words.sz: 你聽從她的忠告是明智的。
words.d: A sensible person or thing is good and smart.

t: 较远的； 不可告人的， 隐秘的， 秘密的
勤奋的， 勤勉的， 勤劳的
words.s: Dennis was very industrious, so he never had problems finding a job.
words.d: If someone is industrious, they work hard.

words.s: I suspect that they water down the beer in that pub.
words.sz: 我怀疑那家酒馆的啤酒兑水了。
words.d: To suspect something is to believe that it might be true.

t: 停留， 逗留； 容忍， 忍受
计划， 图谋； 设计； 发明
大而重的， 厚实的， 粗大的； 大量的， 大规模的
words.s: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.
words.sz: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
words.d: A massive thing is very big.

t: 混合， 联结； 相往来； 混杂其中

words.s: This fish is not edible.
words.sz: 这条鱼不能吃了。

t: 合唱，合唱曲；合唱队；副歌，叠句；齐声，齐声说的话

words.s: I owe it you that I am still alive.
words.sz: 多亏了你，我还活着。

words.s: The coach realized the boy’s speed was an asset to the team.
words.d: An asset is a skill or quality that is useful or valuable.

words.s: What's the minimum wage in your country?
words.sz: 你的国家的最低工资是多少？
words.d: The minimum is the smallest amount.

words.s: The magician used magic to pull a rabbit out of his hat.
words.d: Magic is the power to do impossible things.

t: 顽强的； 坚硬的； 不能弯曲的， 坚固的
揭露； 泄露； 展现

words.d: To condemn someone means to give them a specific punishment.

t: 贸易， 商业； 交往， 交流

words.sz: 英語在商業中很有用。
words.d: Commerce is the activity of buying and selling things.

words.s: We need assistance.
words.sz: 我們需要幫助。

t: 定义， 释义； 清晰

words.sz: 我想知道咱们是否有足够的钱给汤姆买他想要的这幅画。
words.d: To wonder is to ask yourself questions or have a need to know.

words.sz: 跟我们的房子比，你的就是个豪宅。
words.d: A mansion is a large and expensive home.

words.sz: 離開前我必須刮鬍子。
words.d: To shave means to cut the hairs on one’s face with a sharp tool.

words.d: A summary is a short statement that contains the main information about something.

words.s: I find it difficult to accustom myself to new time zones when I travel around the world.
words.d: To accustom oneself to something is to get used to it.

t: 较差的， 次的， 低劣的； 级别低的， 较低的
下级； 下属， 晚辈

words.d: An inferior thing is not as good as something else.

words.d: The spine is the group of bones that run up and down the middle of the back.

words.sz: 明尼苏达州的官方鸟就是蚊子。

words.sz: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
words.d: If something is artificial, it was not made naturally but mimics something natural.

words.s: Your snack has a deficiency of any real nutrients.
words.d: A deficiency is a lack of something, especially something that is needed.

t: 除去； 免职； 搬迁

words.sz: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。

t: 超越， 胜过， 优于
人文主义的， 人性的

words.d: To employ someone means to give work to them.

words.s: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.
words.sz: 实验室里的空调坏了。

t: 值得拥有的； 合意的； 可取的， 有利的

words.sz: 得不到的东西就最想得到。

words.s: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
words.sz: 把你的失败归咎于你的父母是不对的。
words.d: Fair means reasonable or right.

words.s: The family is eating breakfast on the balcony.
words.sz: 一家人在陽臺上吃早飯。

t: 准备， 预备； 制剂
words.s: We failed due to a lack of preparation.
words.sz: 我們因缺乏準備而失敗了。

t: 由…组成， 由…构成； 在于， 存在于
words.s: Today’s choices for lunch consisted of pizza, hamburgers, and hot dogs.
words.d: To consist of certain is to be made of parts or things them.

words.s: Jan and Fred are too different. They will never be compatible.
words.d: When things are compatible, they work well or exist together successfully.

t: 批评家； 爱挑剔的人
words.s: The wine critic tasted the wine so he could give his opinion.
words.d: A critic is someone who gives opinions about movies, books, plays, etc.

t: 使能够， 使成为可能
words.s: Studying hard will enable the girl to get a good job.
words.d: To enable is to make it possible for something to happen.

words.sz: 因为台风的关系，我的父母提早一天结束了旅行回到家。
words.d: A typhoon is a large tropical storm that moves in circles.

t: 行业， 职业； 宣称， 表白
words.s: Teaching English is his profession.
words.sz: 教英语是他的职业。

words.s: I compressed my clothes to fit into a single suitcase.
words.d: To compress something means to press or squeeze it so that it takes up less space.

words.s: She glanced briefly at the newspaper.
words.sz: 她很快地瞟了一眼報紙。

t: 想象； 想象出来的事物
words.s: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
words.sz: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。

t: 反抗， 抵制； 抵抗力， 抵抗性； 阻力； 电阻

words.s: I found the key underneath the mat.
words.sz: 我在擦鞋墊下面發現了這把鑰匙。
words.d: Underneath means below or under.

t: 令人愉快的， 使人快乐的
words.s: I had an enjoyable two weeks in London.
words.sz: 我在倫敦度過了愉快的兩週。

words.s: What's your favorite nursery rhyme?
words.sz: 你最喜歡的兒童歌曲是哪首？
words.d: A nursery is a room where babies and children sleep, play, or are cared for.

t: 谱， 光谱， 频谱； 范围， 幅度
words.s: You can see the entire spectrum in a rainbow.
words.d: The spectrum is the full range of color ranging from red to violet.

words.s: The princess begged forgiveness from the emperor.
words.sz: 公主向皇帝请求饶恕。
words.d: An emperor is the leader of a group of countries.

t: 陈旧的， 过时的； 废弃的

words.s: I asked for a refund because the shoes I bought were too tight.
words.d: A refund is money given back to a person when an item is returned to a store.

t: 柴油； 柴油机； 柴油车
陡峭的； 过高的； 急剧的
words.s: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
words.sz: 這條小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。
words.d: A steep surface or place has a slope or angle that rises or falls sharply.

t: 隔离的， 分离的； 与世隔绝的， 偏僻的； 孤立的， 孤独的； 个别的

words.sz: 好几间小屋被洪水孤立起来了。

t: 古典的； 传统的； 经典的
words.s: I always enjoy listening to classical music when I have some free time.
words.sz: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。
words.d: Classical music is more formal and serious than popular music.

t: 给予特权， 特别优待
words.s: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.
words.sz: 我们得到了在这个海湾内捕鱼的特权。
words.d: A privilege is a special right given only to a certain person or group of people.

words.s: When I ran out of juice, I had to substitute water to drink in the morning.
words.d: To substitute something or someone means to have them take the place of another.

t: 停止； 中断； 不连续

words.sz: 汤姆换上制服。
words.d: A uniform is a piece of clothing worn by people of the same group.

words.s: The small fire soon blazed into a large, dangerous one.
words.d: To blaze means to burn brightly or powerfully.

words.s: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
words.sz: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。

t: 散开， 驱散； 撒； 撒播

words.d: To scatter something is to make it go in many places.

t: 违反， 违犯， 违背； 亵渎； 侵犯， 干扰
words.s: I was given a ticket because the policeman said I violated a traffic law.
words.d: To violate a law, rule, or agreement means to break it.

words.s: He steered the go-cart around the track.
words.d: To steer something is to control where it goes.

words.s: On the whole, the event was successful.
words.sz: 整體而言，這個事件是成功的。
words.d: An event is something that happens, especially something important.

t: 机构； 代理， 代办

words.sz: 我們需要人力仲介公司幫我們找到合適的人來擔任這個管理職位。

t: 优惠券； 票证； 配给券； 参赛表， 订货单

words.sz: 一些抽象藝術是很難理解的。
words.d: An abstract thing is an idea or thought, not a physical thing.

words.sz: 讓我們繼續進行議程上的項目。
words.d: An agenda is a plan or goal that guides someone’s behavior.

words.s: Judging from his appearance, he must be a rich man.
words.sz: 从他的外表来看，他应该是个有钱人。

words.s: I think Tom is going to be pretty mad when he finds out that the painting he bought is a fake.
words.sz: 我觉得当汤姆发现他买来的画是赝品的时候，他会很生气。
words.d: A fake thing is made to look real in order to trick people.

words.s: The life span of a butterfly is short.
words.sz: 蝴蝶的寿命短。
words.d: To span is to spread across an amount of time or space.

t: 奇形怪状的； 怪诞的

words.sz: 多么荒唐的故事！

t: 对…进行民意测验； 获得…选票

words.d: A poll is a survey in which people give their opinions about important things.

words.d: A reference is the act of referring to something or someone.

words.s: The meeting was held in the faculty chamber.
words.d: A chamber is a closed space or room used for a special purpose.

words.sz: 尽管雨下得很大，但他还是去医院看望他的朋友了。

words.s: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.
words.sz: 我会安排一下，叫个人去你家接你。
words.d: To arrange things is to put them in the right place.

t: 使显得不重要， 轻视， 淡化
宣传， 宣扬； 公众的注意， 名声

words.d: Publicity is public attention given to someone or something by the media.

words.s: How often do the buses depart?
words.sz: 公共汽车多久发车一次？
words.d: To depart is to leave some place so you can go to another place.

委托； 许诺； 承担义务

words.sz: 在我手裡的是一個貝殼化石。

words.d: A collision is the act of two things hitting into each another.

words.sz: 生产日期在盖子上。
words.d: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory.

words.s: Agatha couldn’t play the piano anymore because of her arthritis.
words.d: Arthritis is an illness causing pain and swelling in a person’s joints.

words.s: My sister is on a low-calorie diet for fitness training.
words.d: A calorie is a unit of heat used to measure how much energy a food will produce.

t: 干涉， 干预， 介入
装得太多， 装到满溢
劝告， 忠告； 建议， 意见

words.sz: 如果我们照了汤姆的话去做这一切都是没必要的。
words.d: Advice is an opinion about what to do.

words.s: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
words.sz: 水星是我們的太陽系中最小的行星。

t: 频繁的， 常见的， 常用的
words.s: Except for the bad weather and the frequent earthquakes, this is almost a perfect place to live.
words.sz: 這裡除了惡劣的天氣和頻繁的地震之外，幾乎就是一個完美的居住地。

t: 相互作用； 相互影响

words.d: To interact is to talk to or do something with another person.

t: 会员身份； 全体会员

words.sz: 我申請成為協會會員。

words.sz: 不要嫉妒其他人的成功。

words.s: He disappeared without a trace.
words.sz: 他没有留下痕迹就消失了。
words.d: To trace something means to follow over it with the eyes or a finger.

t: 大气的， 空气的； 大气层的； 大气所引起的

words.s: The toy cars are available in an array of colors.
words.d: An array is a large group or number of things.

t: 努力， 尽力； 尝试

words.sz: 我們會盡力在這禮拜結束前把工作完成。

words.s: I don't discriminate.
words.sz: 我不歧视人。

t: 发出蒸汽； 行驶； 用蒸汽开动
words.s: Water turns into steam when it is boiled.
words.sz: 水沸腾后变为蒸汽。

words.s: The green and brown camouflage was best used for hiding in forests and jungles.
words.d: Camouflage is something used to hide people and things.

words.s: My business has at last gotten on the right track.
words.sz: 我的生意终于走上了正轨。

words.sz: 我得還債。

words.sz: 一般來說，消费者喜歡數量勝於質量。
words.d: A quantity is a certain amount of something.

words.s: What time is the next performance?
words.sz: 下一場表演在幾點鐘？
words.d: Performance is how well someone or something functions, works, etc.

t: 当前， 现时， 目前

words.sz: 我們目前正在尋找具有客服工作經驗的人員。

words.sz: 汤姆不知道玛丽是个连环杀手。

words.s: The ambassador was recalled from Warsaw.
words.sz: 大使被从华沙召回。
words.d: An ambassador is a government worker who works in another country.

words.s: I found the comic book very interesting.
words.sz: 我發現這本漫畫書非常有趣。
words.d: When something is comic, it is funny.

words.s: She had a vague feeling of guilt.
words.sz: 她隱約地有一種的內疚感。
words.d: If something is vague, it is not clear and gives very few details.

words.s: What's the round-trip fare?
words.sz: 往返票多少钱？
words.d: A fare is an amount of money paid to use a bus, train, or taxi.

t: 偶然发生的， 不定期的； 由许多片段组成的， 松散的

words.s: Accuracy is important in arithmetic.
words.sz: 准确性在计算中很重要。

words.s: I live in a home with my spouse and our two children.
words.d: A spouse is the person to whom someone is married.

t: 环境； 背景； 安置

得分， 分数； 乐谱； 抓痕， 划痕； 二十
words.s: He got a better score than us.
words.sz: 他得到了比我们还高的分数。

t: 缓刑； 试用； 试用期

words.sz: 湯姆正在緩刑中。

words.s: His writing was full of quotes from Shakespeare.
words.d: A quote is what someone has said, including saying how much a piece of work will cost.

words.s: Tom will graduate from high school the year after next.
words.sz: 湯姆將在後年高中畢業。
words.d: To graduate from a school means to complete and pass all courses of study there.

t: 定额， 限额， 配额
一致同意的； 一致通过的

words.sz: 选举一致通过了。

words.s: The rugged terrain made the troops' advance difficult.
words.sz: 地面高低不平，給部隊前進帶來了困難。
words.d: The terrain is the land and all of its physical features or parts.

t: 几乎， 差不多； 实际上， 事实上

words.sz: 他是一位優秀的科學家，更是一位偉大的詩人。
words.d: When something is excellent, it is very good.

t: 相当地； 公平地； 简直， 完全地

words.sz: 湯姆看來是箇很成功的商人。

words.s: The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.
words.sz: 一个国家纸的产量和它的文明程度密切相关。

words.s: His nationality is German, but he speaks French, Spanish, and Korean.
words.d: Nationality is an identity based on the nation from which you come.

t: 倒塌， 倒下； 打倒， 推翻
市的， 市政的； 地区的； 内政的
words.s: The municipal parking lot downtown can fit one hundred cars.
words.d: Municipal means that something belongs to a city or local government.

words.s: I am going to a lecture about Ancient Rome at the Historical Institute.
words.d: An institute is an organization that is interested in research or teaching.

t: 忍受； 持久， 持续
words.s: Can she endure a long trip?
words.sz: 她能忍受長途旅行嗎？
words.d: To endure means to experience and survive something difficult.

words.s: She had to accept her fate.
words.sz: 她该接受她的命运。
words.d: Fate is a power that causes things to happen.

words.s: The essence of the argument was that both sides felt they had lost money.
words.d: The essence of something is its important qualities or basic characteristics.

words.s: Can you drive a manual transmission?
words.sz: 你會開手排車嗎?

t: 犹豫， 迟疑； 不确定； 无把握
