对…感到不满； 嫉妒； 勉强做， 不乐意地做
退休； 引退， 退隐， 撤退
words.s: I hope to retire from work when I'm 60 years old.
words.sz: 我希望在六十歲時退休。
words.d: To retire is to leave a job, usually because of old age.

t: 方面； 朝向， 方向； 外貌， 外观样子
words.s: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
words.sz: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。
words.d: An aspect is one part or feature of something.

words.s: Tom's new girlfriend is a vegetarian.
words.sz: 汤姆新的女朋友是素食主义者。
words.d: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat any meat products.

words.s: He is an aggressive person.
words.sz: 他是个咄咄逼人的的人。
words.d: If someone is aggressive, then they constantly want to fight or argue.

t: 弹性， 弹力； 复原力； 适应性； 乐观的性情

words.s: The United Nations is a federation designed to prevent war, disease, and famine.
words.d: A federation is a group of states or businesses working for a common cause.

t: 整体的， 全面的； 功能整体性的

words.s: He can swing a golf club very powerfully.
words.d: To swing something means to move it back and forth or from side to side.

words.s: In Korea, walls were built around cities to protect them from invasions.
words.d: An invasion is an attack by a group from another country.

t: 先例， 范例； 惯例
words.s: He set a precedent.
words.sz: 他開了先河。

words.s: The boy kept spinning until he fell down.
words.d: To spin is to turn around in circles.

浅的； 肤浅的， 浅薄的

words.d: A shallow thing is not deep.

t: 宇宙空间； 航空航天技术
并行的； 间接的， 附带的

words.s: He emerged from the pool and spit water from his mouth.
words.d: To spit means to force liquid from one’s mouth.

侦察； 寻找； 搜索

words.sz: 請您在登記冊上簽名好嗎？

words.d: Conversion is the act of changing something into a different state or form.

words.sz: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。

words.sz: 鹽可以幫助保存食物避免腐爛。

words.s: Clothing made out of synthetic fabrics is very effective at keeping people warm.
words.d: If something is synthetic, then it is made to be like something natural.

t: 宣告， 宣布， 声明； 显示

words.sz: 形势似乎非常紧张严峻。

t: 心理的， 精神的； 智力的

words.d: If something is mental, it has to do with your mind.

words.sz: 這個女孩做了一把很難使用的弓。

t: 大方的， 体面的， 像样的； 正派的， 合乎礼仪的

words.sz: 湯姆是箇誠實的孩子。
words.d: A decent person or thing is OK or good enough.

words.sz: 他晚年致力於寫自傳。
words.d: An autobiography is a true story of a person’s life written by that person.

words.sz: 把灯打开。我什么都看不见了。

words.d: When something is viable, it is capable of doing what it is intended to do.

words.sz: 汤姆试过还回泳衣来换成更大一号的，但是员工告诉他那是不被允许的。

t: 休眠的； 静止的； 隐匿的
承认， 确认； 致意； 感谢

words.d: To acknowledge something is to accept that it is true or that it exists.

words.s: Meet me at the lobby of the Imperial Hotel at 6:30 p.m.
words.sz: 下午六点半到帝国酒店的大堂找我。

t: 遗传的， 遗传性的； 可继承的， 世袭的
把…强加给， 使遭受， 使承受
姿势； 观点， 立场
words.s: My stance is that using oil and gas is bad for the environment.
words.d: A stance is an attitude about an issue that someone states clearly.

words.s: The river curved inland near the campground.
words.d: If someone goes inland, they travel into the center of a country or land.

t: 值得花费时间的， 值得做的
words.s: On his visit to Canada, he realized studying English was worthwhile.
words.d: If something is worthwhile, it is important or useful.

words.sz: 时装不是我的天分。

words.sz: 我的手肘還在痛。

t: 改变； 多样化； 变化； 不同

words.s: This meal is adequate for three.
words.sz: 这饭足够三个人吃。
words.d: Something adequate is good enough.

words.s: Have you ever seen sausage being made?
words.sz: 你见过灌肠的做法吗？

t: 极大的， 巨大的； 非常的， 惊人的
words.s: The pressure was tremendous.
words.sz: 壓力很巨大。
words.d: A tremendous thing is very large or very good.

t: 逐步增长或发展， 逐步升级
压缩， 精简； 凝结
words.s: The cool air made tiny drops of water condense on the tops of the grass.
words.d: To condense a gas means to make it a liquid.

t: 使绕道， 转移； 娱乐， 供消遣
正义， 公正； 司法
words.s: Justice will prevail in the end.
words.sz: 正义终将胜利。
words.d: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

words.s: I'm going to run a couple of errands. Wanna tag along?
words.sz: 我要去购物。你要跟着来吗？

words.s: Tom is used to cooking on a campfire.
words.sz: 湯姆習慣用營火做菜。

words.s: When Tom found out about that, he was furious.
words.sz: 当汤姆发现这件事时，他很生气。

t: 晒成棕褐色， 晒黑； 硝
words.s: He doesn't tan.
words.sz: 他晒不黑。

t: 轻拍； 利用， 开发
words.s: There's a chance that tap water may contain harmful substances like chlorine and lead.
words.sz: 自來水有可能含有氯、鉛等有害物質。
words.d: To tap something is to hit it lightly.

words.s: Each individual is responsible for themselves.
words.d: An individual is a single member of a group.

words.s: I left my briefcase on the bus.
words.sz: 我把我的公事包留在公車上了。

words.s: Jim cannot join us because he is constrained by previous plans.
words.d: To constrain something means to limit its development.

t: 激动； 兴奋； 令人兴奋的事
提供消息或情报的人， 线人； 提供资料的人
野蛮的， 粗鲁的； 残暴的， 残忍的； 原始部落的
实施， 执行； 强制， 迫使
words.s: Police enforce traffic laws to keep everyone safe.
words.d: To enforce means to make a person follow a rule.

t: 脆弱的； 虚弱的； 易碎的； 易受伤害的
words.s: The fragile glassware was carefully packed into boxes.
words.d: When people or things are fragile, they are not strong and can be damaged easily.

t: 离开， 出发； 背离， 违反
words.s: With the weather getting worse, the departure was put off.
words.sz: 由于天气变差，出发延迟了。
words.d: A departure is the act of leaving a place.

t: 需细心的，辛苦的，煞费苦心的；勤勉的；刻苦的
辛苦； 勤勉； 刻苦
words.s: This is painstaking work.
words.sz: 這是一項艱苦的工作。

t: 发胖的， 肥胖的， 强壮的； 结实的， 牢固的； 顽强的， 坚毅的

words.s: Sociology teaches that people’s problems are a result of their society.
words.d: Sociology is the study of human society, its organizations, and problems.

words.s: When a predator approaches a deer, the deer will flee.
words.d: To flee is to leave somewhere very quickly in order to escape from danger.

t: 清楚的， 明显的； 有区别的， 不同的
words.d: A distinct thing is different or stands out.

words.s: Because he studied geology, he knew how the mountains were formed.
words.d: Geology is the study of the Earth’s natural structures and how they change.

words.s: She played a tune on the piano.
words.sz: 她在鋼琴上彈了一首曲子。

words.s: It's hard to believe that Tom wasn't aware that Mary was in love with him.
words.sz: 真难相信汤姆不知道玛丽爱他。
words.d: If someone is aware, they know that something or a situation exists.

t: 〔对物件起保护作用的〕罩，盖，套
words.s: I paid ten dollars for this cap.
words.sz: 我付了十美元買這頂帽子。

words.s: He got an award for having the best grades in class.
words.d: An award is a prize for doing something well.

t: 符合条件的； 合适的
words.s: If he were a little younger, he would be eligible for the post.
words.sz: 如果他年轻一点，他将很适合这个职位。
words.d: If someone is eligible, then they are permitted to do or have something.

words.s: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.
words.sz: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。
words.d: A stove is a device used to cook food.

t: 惊恐，恐慌；报警器；闹钟；警报
words.s: It's much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.
words.sz: 被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。
words.d: An alarm is something that warns people of danger.

words.s: Tom said he thought that he'd be able to help Mary weed the garden today.
words.sz: 汤姆说他以为他今天能够帮玛丽的花园除草

words.s: The North Pole is covered by a huge glacier.
words.d: A glacier is a large piece of ice that moves very slowly.

t: 顺利的； 流畅的； 协调的
words.s: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.
words.sz: 將混合物攪拌均勻。
words.d: A smooth thing has no bumps or rough parts.

t: 定位； 方向， 方位； 情况介绍； 培训， 训练

words.s: No one supported his motion.
words.sz: 沒人支持他的動議。
words.d: A motion is a movement that someone makes.

words.s: The earthworm wriggled when I touched it.
words.sz: 我碰蚯蚓的时候，它扭动起来。

t: 火柴；比赛，竞赛；对手，敌手
words.s: I always get nervous just before a match.
words.sz: 比赛前我一直都很紧张。
words.d: To match is to be the same or similar.

t: 缺点， 瑕疵， 毛病
words.s: He is constantly finding fault with other people.
words.sz: 他总是挑别人的毛病。
words.d: A fault is responsibility for a mistake.

t: 相互作用， 相互影响
碎片， 小部分， 片断
words.s: After the light broke, there were fragments of glass to clean up.
words.d: A fragment is a small part of something.

t: 回答， 答复； 反应， 响应
words.s: I'm sorry for the late response.
words.sz: 我很抱歉回复晚了。
words.d: A response is the answer to a question.

t: 种类； 类别； 范畴
竞争者，竞争对手；可与匹敌的人
与…竞争； 与…匹敌， 比得上； 竞争， 对抗
words.s: The three rivals were all competing for the same job.
words.d: A rival is someone trying to achieve the same thing as another.
